messages:
Anya: Heads up — 99p latency for /v1/embeddings spiked to ~1.2s around 08:12 UTC. Looks correlated with a tenant sending mixed 1536/768 vectors in one payload. Logs show splitter falling back to slow path and several 413s.
Ming: Can you paste the sample payload? I want to check if we're miscomputing cost per request vs per-dimension.
Anya: here's anonymized payload snippet:
```
{ "model": "open-embed-1536", "inputs": [[...768 floats...], [...1536 floats...], ...] }
```
Frank: I think our route-cost estimator is using total bytes to pick route, not per-item dim. Mixed dims -> route to generic path that can't use dim-specialized kernels. We should detect per-item dim distribution earlier in ingress.
Sophia: Console idea: show 'per-tenant dim distribution' histogram in embeddings dashboard + a 'estimated unit cost' column. Ops can then see who is sending mixed dims. :chart_with_upwards_trend: 
Ming: Agreed. Short-term fix: add header `x-embed-dim-hint: 1536` that client can opt into to force route to optimized 1536 kernel. That avoids splitter fallback for homogeneous batches, but we need to prevent lying headers.
Frank: How guard? We can add a preflight that samples first N items and reject if mismatch > 10% with 400 + guidance. Or accept but flag telemetry. PromQL I used to find samples:
```
sum(rate(embeddings_requests_total{route="generic_fallback"}[5m])) by (tenant)
```
InfraBot: deploy-bot: rolled out ingress preflight v2 to canary (tenants: test-*, dev-*) at 09:03 UTC :white_check_mark:
Anya: Plan: (1) add dim-hint header opt-in (2) surface dim histogram + per-route cost in console (3) preflight sampling and telemetry gating before wider rollout. Who wants to own console tile?
Sophia: I can take the console tile. Will mock in FigJam and post tomorrow. :+1:
Ming: I'll pick up the ingress header + preflight sampling. Frank can you do telemetry events and Prom rules?
Frank: Yep. I'll add a new event `embed_dim_mismatch` and dashboard panel. Will follow up with PR.
